16 teams participated in the '''1997–98 Egyptian Premier League season'''. The first team in the league was the champion, and qualified to [[CAF Champions League 1999|CAF Champions League]], while the runner up qualified to the [[1999 CAF Cup|CAF Cup]]. The season started on 27 September 1997 and concluded on 9 June 1998.
[[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] won the league for the 27th time in the club's history.<ref>[[:ar:الدوري المصري الممتاز 1997–98]]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9798.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131201627/http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9798.html|url-status=usurped|archive-date=January 31, 2021|title=Dr.Tarek Said's Homepage - Egyptian Soccer League 1997/98|website=drtareksaid.net}}</ref>
